correctness.rationale: The source gives the exact positive four-braid \(\beta_n\), genus \(g(K_n)=n+11\), braid index \(4\), hyperbolicity, and the common Dehn-filling parent. Counting the braid word gives \(2n+25\) crossings. For every knot diagram, the canonical Seifert surface gives \(c_D\ge2g(K)+s_D-1\); Yamada identifies \(\min s_D=b(K)\), hence \(c(K)\ge2g(K)+b(K)-1\). Equality follows for this braid. Strict hyperbolic Dehn-filling volume decrease then gives the uniform parent-volume bound, and division by \(2n+25\) proves the density limit.

value.rationale: The family realizes the sharp minimal braid-index boundary for asymmetric L-space knots. Proving exact crossing-minimality and combining it with a single hyperbolic filling parent yields a structural separation: at constant minimal braid index \(4\), crossing complexity grows linearly without bound while volume stays uniformly bounded, so volume density collapses to zero. This is a natural relation among central knot invariants, not a routine table recomputation.
